FIDDLY BITS

Settings

Difficulty

Attacking

Auto attack: your hero attacks the nearest enemy by itself, so you only need to move, dodge and use your ultimate. Press T in a run to switch it.

Speedrun timer

Shows a run clock under the map, with a time for each level you finish. Totally optional.

Tips

Short tips the first time something new turns up. Each one only shows once.

Story scenes

Short comic scenes at the start of later levels and at the very end. Each plays once, and you can watch them again in Case files.

Calmer screen

Turns down camera shake, hit flashes and bright white bursts.

Text size

Makes menus, speech bubbles and messages bigger.

Colour vision

Swaps colours that can be hard to tell apart, and adds labels where colour carries meaning.

Enemy warnings

High visibility shows attack warnings as bold yellow and black stripes.

Sound captions

Shows important sounds as words, like [BOOM] or [DOOR OPENS], with an arrow pointing where they came from.

Volume

Background sounds

Traffic in the City, creaks in the mansion, twinkles in Dream land, machines in the lair.

Character voices

Little babble sounds when characters speak.

Graphics

Fastest turns off glow, blur and soft shadows. Good for older Chromebooks. Lightest also draws at a lower resolution with fewer particles, for very slow machines.

Frame rate counter

Shows how smoothly the game is running, in the bottom corner. Handy for checking school laptops.

Keys

Choose an action, then press the key you would like to use. Esc cancels.

Camera

A turning camera lets you look around. A fixed camera never turns, so up on the screen is always north, the same as the map.

Map

A turning map always matches the screen: up on the map is the way you are facing, and a red N shows north. Or keep north at the top.

Controller rumble

Unlock everything

For Jay and LW to test the game. Unlocks every hero, Box-man mode, outfits, second passives, mastery, items, combos, case files, notes and story scenes, and adds 200 stickers for the workshop. Your old save is kept, so you can put it back.

Start new runs in

Skips ahead, with the weapon upgrades and a few scraps you would have earned on the way. Daily runs, challenges and practice still start as normal.

Go straight to the boss

Starts the run in that level's boss room.

Save code

Your progress saves on this computer by itself. To carry it to another computer, copy this code and load it there.

Something went wrong?

Makes a bug report you can copy and send to Jay.

EXTRAS

Extras

DIRECTOR ONLY

LW's voice studio

Record any lines you like, in any order, and skip the rest. Say the words shown, or anything you fancy. Your recordings play in the game instead of the beeps. Each line can be up to 8 seconds.

Share

A voice pack is a backup of every recording in one file. Save one to keep safe, or load one from another device.

DIRECTOR ONLY

LW's room designer

Build a fight room from the top. Put pillars, walls, pits and stages wherever you like, then choose which criminals turn up and when. Your rooms can turn up in runs.

Workshop

Every run earns stickers, win or lose. Spend them on small upgrades that help on every run. You can switch any of them off again.
